errors.what: Crank does not complete a full revolution in 4 s. Over the 12 frames (t=0 to 3.67 s) the crank pin only moves from 0 deg to about 95-100 deg, roughly 8-10 deg per frame instead of 30 deg. The crank angular speed is about a third of the specified 90 deg/s, so the period is wrong and the piston never returns to its starting position. Link lengths, CCW direction and joint connectivity look correct.
